g.title: cluster_legend
g.text: Legend — solid: owns · dark: relationship · dashed: reference

a.xlink:title: Show how one field that can point to different kinds of concept is modeled with existing node kinds.
Own the people and organizations other domains refer to.
Own deals and the parties taking part in them.
Own free-form notes and what each note is about.
Let a seller add a person or an organization as a party to a deal.
a.text: Add a party to a deal

a.xlink:title: A party references exactly one of a person or an organization, never both and never neither.
Represent a company or institution that deals and notes can refer to.
Represent an individual that deals and notes can refer to.
Represent a commercial opportunity with one or more parties.
Represent one side of a deal, which is either a person or an organization.
A party that is an organization.
A party that is a person.
Record a free-form observation about any number of people, organizations, and deals.
A note may be about any number of people, organizations, and deals, in any mix; each subject it lists resolves to an existing record.
